lru-cache.title: LRU Cache

lru-cache.idea: HashMap + doubly linked list; move to front on get/put, evict from the tail. (LinkedHashMap with accessOrder is the shortcut.)

max-stack.idea: Doubly linked list for stack order + TreeMap<val, Deque<Node>> for max; popMax unlinks from the middle. O(log n).
